column1: What is the solution of a system of two linear equations, as a picture?
column2: The point where the two lines cross.

column1: Three possible outcomes for two lines?
column2: One solution (cross), no solution (parallel), infinitely many (same line).
Solve one equation for a variable and put that expression into the other equation.
Add or subtract the equations (after scaling) so one variable cancels.

column1: Why is adding two equations allowed?
column2: Equal amounts added to equal amounts stay equal.
The equations describe the same line: infinitely many solutions.
